xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes:

1. The Statement of unaudited standalone financial results ('the Statement') of Timken India Limited ('the Company') for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026 has been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on October 29, 2026. The Statement has been subjected to limited review by Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP, the statutory auditor of the Company. The report of the statutory auditor is unmodified.
2. The Company has only one reportable primary segment, viz. 'Bearings and allied goods & services'. Accordingly, no separate segment disclosures is required under "Ind AS-108 - Operating Segments".
3. The Statement has been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 ("the Act") read with relevant Rules issued thereunder ('IND AS') and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and guidelines issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India ("SEBI").
4. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company has paid final dividend of Rs. 2.50/- per equity share to all eligible shareholders as recommended by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 18, 2026 and approved by the shareholders at 39th Annual General Meeting held on August 18, 2026.
5. The Statement of Assets and Liabilities as at September 30, 2026 is given as Annexure-A and Statement of Cash Flows for the half year ended September 30, 2026 is given as Annexure-B.
6. The Board of Directors of the Company at it’s meeting held on May 18, 2026 approved a draft Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Timken GGB Technology Private Limited with the Company and their respective shareholders and creditors ("the Scheme") with effect from the appointed date of April 01, 2026 pursuant to the provisions of Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 (“the Act”) and the Rules made thereunder. The Company has filed petition before National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru Bench seeking its approval for the Scheme in the month of July 2026, which is pending for approval as on the date.
